notes.auth: HTTP Basic authentication. Credentials (API login and password) from https://app.dataforseo.com/api-access. Header: 'Authorization: Basic <base64(login:password)>' sent on every request over HTTPS. A 401 (internal status_code 40100) means bad/missing credentials.
notes.sandbox: Free testing environment. Swap the production host for the sandbox host: production https://api.dataforseo.com/v3/, sandbox https://sandbox.dataforseo.com/v3/ (e.g. https://sandbox.dataforseo.com/v3/serp/google/organic/task_post). Responses have the exact same structure/fields as production but contain generic dummy/random data, and your account is NOT charged. Same auth and rate limits apply. Use it to build/configure integrations without spending credits; not for real data.
notes.rateLimits: Up to 2,000 API calls per minute for POST requests; maximum 30 simultaneous/concurrent requests per user. Up to 100 tasks per POST array for Standard (queue) methods; Live methods allow only 1 task per request. Some appendix utility endpoints are more tightly self-limited (user_data ~6/min, status ~10/min). Rate-limit headers X-RateLimit-Limit / X-RateLimit-Remaining are returned. Exceeding the per-minute limit returns internal status_code 40202.
notes.asyncFlow: Standard (queue) mode is asynchronous: POST to a .../task_post endpoint (returns a task id with status_code 20100 'Task Created'); the task is queued (normal ~5 min or high priority ~1 min). Retrieve results one of three ways: (1) Poll .../tasks_ready to get IDs of newly completed, uncollected tasks (each call returns up to 1000 tasks completed within the previous 3 days), then call .../task_get/{id}. (2) postback_url: DataForSEO POSTs the full result to your URL when ready. (3) pingback_url: DataForSEO GETs your URL with the task id when ready, then you call task_get. If your server does not respond within 10 seconds the webhook is aborted and the task falls back to tasks_ready. Live mode is synchronous (1 task/request, results returned immediately, no task_get).
notes.baseUrls: Production: https://api.dataforseo.com/v3/  |  Sandbox: https://sandbox.dataforseo.com/v3/  (all endpoint paths append after /v3/). HTTPS only.
notes.resultStorage: Task results are stored for 30 days after completion and can be re-fetched via task_get by id repeatedly, without extra charge, for 30 days. tasks_ready only surfaces tasks completed within the previous 3 days that have not yet been collected. Per-API .../id_list POST endpoints (backlinks/id_list, on_page/id_list, business_data/id_list, app_data/id_list, etc.) return ids of tasks posted in a datetime range.
notes.responseFormats: JSON by default; envelope contains version, status_code, status_message, time, cost, tasks_count, tasks_error and a tasks array (each task: id, status_code, status_message, cost, result_count, path, data, result). Granular internal status_code (20000 Ok, 20100 Task Created, 40xxx client/auth/queue, 50xxx server/third-party). XML/HTML output available on many endpoints via /xml or /html path suffix; several SERP task_get/live endpoints offer 'regular', 'advanced' and 'html' result variants.
notes.pricingModel: Pay-as-you-go, no subscriptions/tiers, $50 minimum deposit. A ~20% pricing update took effect July 1, 2026, and the former $100/month commitment for Backlinks API and LLM Mentions (AI Optimization) API was removed - both now under the standard pay-as-you-go model. Standard queue is cheaper than Live; Standard has 'priority' (high, ~1 min) and 'normal' (~5 min) tiers. tasks_ready/task_get and reference/utility endpoints (locations, languages, id_list, errors, available_filters, status, user_data) are free.
